content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

John Rodriguez (E049) requests write access to Source Code.

Facts:
- Role: Analyst
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic
- System: Source Code (owned by Engineer role)

Policy:
- Contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- He has basic security training, not advanced. So max is read.
- Analyst does not own Source Code, so no ownership admin.

Requested: write. Maximum: read. Since requested is above maximum, grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
